snippet.title: Console Release Date Trailer [Void Crew]
snippet.description:
Console Release Date Incoming! 🎮 
September 4th, 2025! Void Crew is coming to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S 🚀
Yes, full crossplay! Grab your controller, squad up with PC or console friends - right from your comfy couch.

METEM Preserve You 🙏

★彡 SUBSCRIBE 彡★ 
To support the game.

Void Crew 1.1 on Steam NOW - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1063420/Void_Crew/ Check it out!  ^_^

--------------------
VOID CREW is a chaotic, co-op Roguelite for 1 to 6 players – Outfit your spaceship and crew for thrilling quests, brave fierce enemies in space battles... and try not to panic!
--------------------

💬 Join our community on Discord! https://discord.gg/JoinVoidCrew

✨🚀 Yeees, please DO it... follow Void Crew ! 🚀✨
Reddit https://www.reddit.com/r/joinvoidcrew/
Twitter https://twitter.com/JoinVoidCrew
Facebook https://www.facebook.com/JoinVoidCrew/
Instagram https://www.instagram.com/joinvoidcrew/ 

All your Void Crew questions answered - Find out more:
https://voidcrew.wiki.gg/wiki/Void_Crew_Wiki
